# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.

server:
  home_dir: /var/lib/gearbox
database:
  servers:
    pg:
      engine: postgres
      host: postgres.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
      port: 5432
      user: integration
      password: ${GEARS_PG_PASSWORD}
      params:
        sslmode: disable
oop_http:
  listen_addr: 0.0.0.0:8090
  advertise_uri: http://checkout.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:8090
  allow_loopback_advertise: false
  internal_auth:
    audiences:
    - toolkit-internal
    provider: kube
    token_path: /var/run/secrets/tokens/toolkit-internal
permissions:
  directory.read:
  - "*"
gears:
  api-contracts-consumer:
    config:
      consumer_wiring:
        api-contracts:
          critical: true
  authn-resolver:
    config: {}
  cluster-sdk:
    config:
      consumer_wiring:
        cluster:
          critical: true
  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      http_client:
        custom_ca_certificate_paths:
        - /app/oidc-ca/ca.crt
      jwt:
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: sub
          subject_tenant_id: tenant_id
          token_scopes: scope
        expected_audience:
        - integration-demo
        trusted_issuers:
        - issuer: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
      s2s_oauth:
        default_subject_type: gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~
        discovery_url: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
  types-registry:
    database:
      server: pg
      dbname: types_registry
    config:
      {}

  advertise_uri: http://cluster.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:8091

  directory.read:
  - "*"
gears:
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles:
        event-broker:
          cache:
            connection_string: >-
              postgres://integration:${GEARS_PG_PASSWORD}@postgres.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:5432/types_registry?sslmode=disable
            pool_max_size: 5
            provider: postgres
            schema: cluster
            secret_ref:
              name: existingSecret:integration-db
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      internal_auth:
        audiences:
        - toolkit-internal
        provider: kube
        token_path: /var/run/secrets/tokens/toolkit-internal
      internal_auth_enforcement: required
      listen_addr: 0.0.0.0:50051

=== helm/integration-demo/Chart.yaml
# GENERATED by gearbox <version> -- do not edit. Run `gearbox generate` to regenerate.
apiVersion: v2
name: integration-demo
description: Generated gearbox chart; workloads live in charts/
type: application
version: "0.1.0"
appVersion: "0.1.0"
dependencies:
  - name: checkout
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/checkout"
    condition: checkout.enabled
  - name: cluster
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/cluster"
    condition: cluster.enabled
  - name: flight-control
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/flight-control"
    condition: flight-control.enabled
  - name: payments
    version: "0.1.0"
    repository: "file://charts/payments"
    condition: payments.enabled

=== helm/integration-demo/charts/checkout/templates/_helpers.tpl
{{- define "checkout.name" -}}
{{- default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.fullname" -}}
{{- if .Values.fullnameOverride }}
{{- .Values.fullnameOverride | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- $name := default .Chart.Name .Values.nameOverride }}
{{- if contains $name .Release.Name }}
{{- .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- else }}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Release.Name $name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.chart" -}}
{{- printf "%s-%s" .Chart.Name .Chart.Version | replace "+" "_" | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.labels" -}}
helm.sh/chart: {{ include "checkout.chart" . }}
{{ include "checkout.selectorLabels" . }}
{{- if .Chart.AppVersion }}
app.kubernetes.io/version: {{ .Chart.AppVersion | quote }}
{{- end }}
app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: {{ .Release.Service }}
{{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonLabels }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}{{- end }}
{{- with .Values.commonLabels }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.annotations" -}}
{{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}{{- end }}
{{- with .Values.commonAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml . }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.selectorLabels" -}}
app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ include "checkout.name" . }}
app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
{{- end }}

{{- define "checkout.serviceAccountName" -}}
{{- if .Values.serviceAccount.create }}
{{- default (include "checkout.fullname" .) .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- else }}
{{- default "default" .Values.serviceAccount.name }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/checkout/templates/configmap.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ include "checkout.fullname" . }}-config
  labels:
    {{- include "checkout.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with (include "checkout.annotations" . | trim) }}
  annotations:
    {{- . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
data:
  checkout.yaml: |
{{ .Files.Get "files/checkout.yaml" | indent 4 }}
=== helm/integration-demo/charts/checkout/templates/deployment.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ include "checkout.fullname" . }}
  labels:
    {{- include "checkout.labels" . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- with (include "checkout.annotations" . | trim) }}
  annotations:
    {{- . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  {{- with .Values.revisionHistoryLimit }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: {{ . }}
  {{- end }}
  {{- with .Values.strategy }}
  strategy:
    {{- toYaml . | nindent 4 }}
  {{- end }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      {{- include "checkout.selectorLabels" . | nindent 6 }}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        {{- include "checkout.selectorLabels" . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- with .Values.global }}{{- with .commonLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}{{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.commonLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.podLabels }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
      annotations:
        checksum/config: {{ include (print $.Template.BasePath "/configmap.yaml") . | sha256sum }}
        {{- with (include "checkout.annotations" . | trim) }}
        {{- . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
        {{- with .Values.podAnnotations }}
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
        {{- end }}
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: {{ include "checkout.serviceAccountName" . }}
      automountServiceAccountToken: {{ .Values.automountServiceAccountToken }}
      {{- with .Values.priorityClassName }}
      priorityClassName: {{ . }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.terminationGracePeriodSeconds }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: {{ . }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.topologySpreadConstraints }}
      topologySpreadConstraints:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.initContainers }}
      initContainers:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- if and .Values.global .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
        {{- range .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
        - name: {{ . }}
        {{- end }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.podSecurityContext }}
      securityContext:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.nodeSelector }}
      nodeSelector:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.affinity }}
      affinity:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      {{- with .Values.tolerations }}
      tolerations:
        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          {{- $registry := .Values.image.registry }}
          {{- if and .Values.global .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- $registry = .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- end }}
          image: "{{ with $registry }}{{ . }}/{{ end }}{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}
          command:
            - "gbx-checkout"
          args:
            - --config
            - /etc/gearbox/checkout.yaml
          {{- with .Values.containerSecurityContext }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          ports:

            - name: http
              containerPort: 8090
              protocol: TCP

          env:
            - name: POD_NAME
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.name
            - name: POD_NAMESPACE
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: metadata.namespace

            - name: TOOLKIT_DIRECTORY_ENDPOINT
              value: "http://flight-control.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local:50052"

            {{- if and .Values.existingSecret .Values.secretKeys }}
            {{- range .Values.secretKeys }}
            - name: {{ . | quote }}
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ $.Values.existingSecret | quote }}
                  key: {{ . | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- with .Values.database }}
            - name: {{ .passwordEnv | quote }}
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .existingSecret | quote }}
                  key: {{ .passwordEnv | quote }}
            {{- end }}
            {{- with .Values.extraEnv }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.startupProbe.enabled }}
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.startupProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.livenessProbe.enabled }}
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.livenessProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.readinessProbe.enabled }}
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /readyz
              port: 8090
            {{- omit .Values.readinessProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          {{- with .Values.resources }}
          resources:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/gearbox/checkout.yaml
              subPath: checkout.yaml
              readOnly: true
            - name: home
              mountPath: /var/lib/gearbox
            {{- with .Values.extraVolumeMounts }}
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
            {{- end }}

      {{- end }}

        {{- toYaml . | nindent 8 }}
      {{- end }}

        - name: cluster
          {{- $registry := .Values.image.registry }}
          {{- if and .Values.global .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- $registry = .Values.global.imageRegistry }}
          {{- end }}

          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.image.pullPolicy }}

            - "gbx-cluster"

            - --config

          {{- with .Values.containerSecurityContext }}
          securityContext:
            {{- toYaml . | nindent 12 }}
          {{- end }}
          ports:

            - name: grpc
              containerPort: 50051
              protocol: TCP

            - name: http
              containerPort: 8091
              protocol: TCP

              valueFrom:

                  fieldPath: metadata.name

              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:

              valueFrom:

            {{- end }}
            {{- end }}

            {{- end }}

            {{- end }}
          {{- if .Values.startupProbe.enabled }}

              port: 8091
            {{- omit .Values.startupProbe "enabled" | toYaml | nindent 12 }}

  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    repository: gbx-payments
    tag: 0.1.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
    name: authz-resolver
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  extraVolumes:
  - name: platform-token
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          audience: toolkit-internal
          expirationSeconds: 3600
          path: toolkit-internal
  extraVolumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
    name: platform-token
    readOnly: true
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 65532
    fsGroup: 65532
  containerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
    capabilities:
      drop:
      - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  startupProbe:
    enabled: false
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 30
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
  homeVolume:
    type: emptyDir
  automountServiceAccountToken: true
  tokenReview: true
  custom: {}

=== helm/integration-demo/values.yaml
# Yours to edit. `gearbox generate` merges its changes into this file and keeps
# yours; an overlap it cannot reconcile is reported as GBX0701 and leaves the
# file untouched. See `values.generated.yaml` for what the lock decided, verbatim.

global:
  commonLabels: {}
  commonAnnotations: {}
checkout:
  database:
    existingSecret: integration-db
    passwordEnv: GEARS_PG_PASSWORD
  enabled: true
  replicaCount: 1
  image:
    repository: gbx-checkout
    tag: 0.1.0
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  serviceAccount:
    create: true
    name: api-contracts-consumer
  resources:
    limits:
      memory: 512Mi
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
  extraVolumes:
  - name: platform-token
    projected:
      sources:
      - serviceAccountToken:
          audience: toolkit-internal
          expirationSeconds: 3600
          path: toolkit-internal
  extraVolumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/tokens
    name: platform-token
    readOnly: true
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 65532
    fsGroup: 65532
  containerSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    seccompProfile:
      type: RuntimeDefault
    capabilities:
      drop:
      - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
  readinessProbe:
    enabled: true
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 3
    successThreshold: 1
  startupProbe:
    enabled: false
    initialDelaySeconds: 0
    periodSeconds: 10
    timeoutSeconds: 1
    failureThreshold: 30
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
  homeVolume:
    type: emptyDir
  automountServiceAccountToken: true
  tokenReview: true
  custom: {}
  existingSecret: integration-db

  enabled: true
  replicaCount: 2

because = "`authz-resolver` names `types-registry` in its `deps`, so the two are linked into one binary and no profile can separate them. Removing that entry is the only thing that can."
